enabledByDefault.Name: Use phases in new combats
enabledByDefault.Hint: New combats start with phased initiative turned on. It can be switched per combat before it starts.

autoAdvance.Name: Advance the phase automatically when everyone marks Done
autoAdvance.Hint: When off, the GM advances every phase by hand.

defaultDc.Name: Default DC
defaultDc.Hint: The DC a new combat starts with. Characters who meet it act in Fast.

showDcToPlayers.Name: Show the DC to players
showDcToPlayers.Hint: When off, only the GM sees the combat's DC.

openOnStart.Name: Show the combat tracker when combat starts
openOnStart.Hint: Brings the combat tab (or its popout) forward on this client whenever a phased combat begins.

phaseTemplate.Name: Phase template
phaseTemplate.Hint: The ordered phases each new combat copies.

theme.Name: Theme
theme.Hint: Colors of the module's screens and of the phase sections, for everyone in this world.

dcSource.Name: Where the DC comes from
dcSource.Hint: Typed: every combat starts with the default DC. Base + CR: the base plus the highest CR among the enemies of the Enemies phase, updated until the combat starts.

dcBase.Name: DC base
dcBase.Hint: Added to the reference CR when the DC is Base + CR. A fractional CR counts 0.

natural20.Name: Critical
natural20.Hint: A natural 20 (or the system's critical: matching duality dice, a d100 01). Automatic: always the first players' phase. One degree: passes if within 9 under the DC, as in Pathfinder 2e.

natural1.Name: Fumble
natural1.Hint: A natural 1 (or the system's fumble). Automatic: always the last players' phase. One degree: fails unless 10 or more over the DC, as in Pathfinder 2e.

suggestFromSheet.Name: Suggest boss phases from the sheet
suggestFromSheet.Hint: An enemy entering a combat goes to the creature phase named exactly like one of its items (a feature called "Boss" goes to Boss; "Boss Fight" does not). Only a default: the GM can still move it.

rollPrompt.Name: Ask me to roll initiative
rollPrompt.Hint: When a character of yours joins a phased combat without a roll, a window asks you to roll. The roll button in the combat tracker stays either way.

rollSource.Name: Roll
rollSource.Hint: The system's own initiative roll keeps every bonus of the sheet. A formula rolls the dice and attribute below instead. Systems without an initiative roll always use the formula.

rollFormula.Name: Formula
rollFormula.Hint: Dice plus @ references to the actor's data, e.g. 1d20 + @abilities.dex.mod. Empty uses the system's default shown in the field.

splitPhases.Name: Movement and actions
splitPhases.Hint: Splits each phase in two: everyone moves first and marks Moved, then everyone acts and marks Done. Leftover movement cannot be used in the actions half. Event phases never split. Applies to new combats.

Config.MenuHint: Phase order, DC and the other options of SC - Venaerys's Initiative.
Config.Title: SC - Venaerys's Initiative · Settings

Phases.Intro: Order of the phases in each round. Combats in progress don't change.
Phases.Band: Party turn: extra phases here act in the middle of it
Phases.BuiltinHint: Built-in phase: can't be deleted or renamed
Phases.RestoreBody: Restore the default phases? The extra phases you created and the names you changed will be lost. Combats in progress don't change.
Phases.DeleteBody: Delete the phase '{name}'? Combats in progress don't change.
Phases.EventHint: Only event markers act in this phase. In combat, the GM adds one with the + on the phase; a combat without a marker skips the phase.

TabHints.world: GM-only rules for every combat in this world.
TabHints.appearance: Colors of the module's screens and phase sections, for everyone in this world. The combatant rows keep Foundry's own look.
TabHints.phases: Order of the phases in each round. Combats in progress don't change.
TabHints.client: Your own preferences, on this computer only.
TabHints.help: How phases behave with turn events, pending combatants and other modules.

Appearance.Previewing: Previewing {theme} on this computer only. Close without saving to go back to {saved}.

Moving.Title: Moving combatants
Moving.Body: During the combat, move a combatant to another phase with the select on its row, by dragging the row onto another phase, or with "Move to phase…" in the row's right-click menu. A moved combatant stays pinned to that phase; choose Automatic to let the roll decide again.

TurnEvents.Title: Turn events
TurnEvents.Body: Automatic start-of-turn effects (recharges, ongoing damage, reaction) happen for every member at the start of the phase. Automatic end-of-turn effects only happen for the member marked with the hourglass (GM only), at the end of the phase. Everyone else resolves end-of-turn effects (saving throws, effects that last until the end of their next turn) by hand when marking Done.

Unconfirmed.Title: Starting without confirmation
Unconfirmed.Body: When a player starts the combat, a player uses Next turn in round 0, or a macro or integration starts it with the confirmed option, there is no confirmation dialog: anyone who has not rolled goes straight to Slow this round.

Pending.Title: Pending combatants
Pending.Body: Anyone who hasn't rolled initiative sits at the end of Foundry's order and gets the system's turn events at the round change. Once they roll, they join the phase their result gives.

Conflicts.Title: Modules with conflicting options
Conflicts.Body: midi-qol: "reroll initiative each round" and "record attacks of opportunity". Combat Tracker Dock: "hide enemies until their first turn". We recommend turning these options off in combats with phases.

Movement.Title: Foundry v14
Movement.Body: In v14, the movement history of every combatant is cleared at each turn start. With phases, that happens at the start of each phase.

Tracker.YouPending: You haven't rolled initiative yet. Roll from the tracker or your sheet.
Tracker.PastLocked: Only the GM can unmark a finished phase.
Tracker.PointerLabel: Automatic turn end: {name} gets the core's end of turn (effects, saving throws) when the phase ends

Gm.PhasesLockedHint: Phases can only be turned on or off in round 0.
Gm.AdvanceLabel: Advance from {phase} to the next phase
Gm.CompleteLabel: Mark everyone in {phase} done and advance
Gm.BackLabel: Go back from {phase} to the previous phase
Gm.AdvanceAnywayHint: Whoever hasn't rolled acts in {slow} this round; if they roll and beat the DC before {fast} ends, they join {fast} right away.
Gm.DialogWaitHint: The phase is complete. Close the dialog or advance now.
Gm.PhaseCompleteHint: Automatic advance is off. Advance when the table is ready.
Gm.NoPhasesHint: Every combatant is defeated or has no phase. The round won't turn by itself.
Gm.Recalculate: Recalculate the DC from base + CR
Gm.DcBaseOnly: The DC is only the base
Gm.DcBaseOnlyHint: No enemy has a CR of 1 or more, so the DC stays at {base}. Type a DC or add enemies.

Start.Title: Start combat
Start.IfStartOne: If you start now, they act in {slow} this round. If they roll and beat the DC before {fast} ends, they join {fast} right away.
Start.IfStartMany: If you start now, they act in {slow} this round. Anyone who rolls and beats the DC before {fast} ends joins {fast} right away.
Start.FastEmpty: Nobody from the party is in {fast} yet: it will be skipped this round.

Notifications.NoEarlierPhase: There is no previous phase: the combat started in this phase. To change who acts now, move the combatant to the current phase.
Notifications.OnlyGmBack: Only the GM can go back phases.
Notifications.Error: SC - Venaerys's Initiative hit an error and fell back to native behavior for this action. Details in the console.
Notifications.TrackerReplaced: Another module replaced the combat tracker: the phases are not shown in it. The phase rules keep running.

Automation.Title: Actions when it starts
Automation.Note: Macros only run if a GM wrote them. Local actions are not shown to players who cannot see the phase.
Automation.DeleteBody: Delete this action from the phase '{phase}'?
Automation.Failed: {phase}: the action "{kind}" failed. Details in the console.
Automation.MacroRefused: The macro '{macro}' was not run: only macros written by a GM run from a phase.
Automation.Local: On every client that sees the phase

Conflicts.midiAutoReroll: Phased combat: midi-qol's "Auto reroll initiative" is on. It rerolls everyone and resets the turn every round, which moves the phase pointer and repeats turn events. Turn it off in midi-qol's optional rules for phased combats.
Conflicts.midiRecordAoo: Phased combat: midi-qol's "Record attacks of opportunity" is on. Every attack by a phase member other than the one under the pointer counts as an attack of opportunity and spends their reaction. Set it to "None" for phased combats.
Conflicts.dockHideFirstRound: Phased combat: Combat Tracker Dock's "Hide until first turn" is on. In round 1 it keeps the enemies of a phase hidden from players until each one is under the pointer. Turn it off for phased combats.

markOwnDone.Name: Mark my combatants done
markOwnDone.Hint: Marks your combatants in the current phase done. For a GM, the combatants no player owns.

advancePhase.Name: Advance phase
advancePhase.Hint: Moves the phased combat to the next phase, like the GM's Next button.

previousPhase.Name: Previous phase
previousPhase.Hint: Moves the phased combat back one phase.

showTracker.Name: Show the combat tracker
showTracker.Hint: Brings the combat tracker forward: its popout if open, otherwise the sidebar tab.

RollPrompt.Title: Roll initiative
RollPrompt.Body: The combat runs in phases. Roll initiative for {names}: beat the DC to act in the first players' phase.

Roll.InvalidFormula: The roll formula "{formula}" is not valid. Fix it in the module settings.
Roll.ProblemTitle: The system's roll can't place anyone
Roll.CocBasicRule: Call of Cthulhu is set to the basic initiative rule: initiative is DEX, nothing is rolled. Switch the system to the optional rule (DEX roll) or set the roll to a formula.
Roll.Experimental: SC - Venaerys's Initiative: support for this system is experimental. Its own combat tracker may move turns and rounds by itself.
